# Universe Bakes and Cakes

> Universe Bakes and Cakes is a bakery located in Nizamabad, Telangana, offering a variety of freshly baked cakes, pastries, desserts, and beverages with a friendly atmosphere.

## Menu
Offers a variety of freshly baked cakes, pastries, and desserts, along with beverages.

## Location & Contact
- Address: Ward no-5, H.no 5, 6-525, Hyderabad Rd, opp. to Pragathi hospital, Pragathi Nagar, Nizamabad, Telangana 503003
- Phone: 089192 47505
- Website: https://universebakesandcakes.com
